entities.name: Benjamina Karić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Benjamina Karić is a Bosnian politician serving as the municipal mayor of Novo Sarajevo since November 2024. She previously served as the 39th mayor of Sarajevo from 2021 to 2024. She has been a member of the Social Democratic Party since 2009.
